title: Improving LLM Reliability with RAG in Religious Question-Answering: MufassirQAS
findings: The Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based system, MufassirQAS, demonstrated superior performance in accuracy and reliability compared to the standard ChatGPT on specific and sensitive Islamic questions. MufassirQAS provided more definitive and well-supported answers by citing its sources from the Quran and Hadith, effectively mitigating the risk of misinformation and hallucination. In contrast, ChatGPT's responses were often more general, ambiguous, or uncertain.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the reliability and accuracy of an LLM-based system in answering religious questions related to Islam. It specifically evaluated the system's ability to prevent hallucinations (inaccurate information), provide contextually grounded answers based on a curated knowledge base of Islamic texts, and handle sensitive religious topics respectfully.
